primary.title: Small-cap stock under ₹100: Roto Pumps shares jump 19% today, soar 28% in 4 days - What's fuelling the rally?
primary.summary: Roto Pumps shares rose 14% on November 12 after the company reported strong Q2 FY27 results. Consolidated net profit jumped 245.3% year-on-year to ₹20.58 crore, while revenue climbed 54.65% to ₹100.15 crore. The board also approved a ₹110 crore loan facility for its wholly owned subsidiary.
